result.summary: Found 1 minor visual issue: malformed text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant card where the delivery time appears broken and unreadable.

issues.description: The delivery time text for Tokumaru Ramen Bar displays as '25-30rdelivery' instead of the expected format like '25-30 min delivery'. The text appears garbled with missing characters and overlapping elements, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text rendering to properly display the delivery time with correct spacing and formatting, such as '25-30 min delivery'.
